answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 149929 Country: UAE Title: A mother has passed away leaving husband, 3 sons, 2 daughters and two sisters. How would her wealth be distributed? Question: A mother has passed away leaving husband, 3 sons, 2 daughters and two sisters. How would her wealth be distributed? Answer ID: 149929 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 648/529/D=7/1438) In the above mentioned case, the wealth of the mother shall be divided into 32 shares, out of the total, her husband shall get 8 shares, 6-6 shares shall go to each son while each daughter shall get 3-3 shares. The sisters shall get nothing. The Shariah division of the property is as follows: Details: Husband: 1x8 = 08 Sons: 3x6 = 18 Daughters: 2x3 = 06 Total: 32 Shares Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
